title: Split fieldwork into fieldwork (pure logic) + fieldwork-db (persistence)
description: Move all *_db.rs modules, db.rs, timeline_db, relationship_db, search_db into a new fieldwork-db crate. fieldwork keeps pure AP logic (actor, activities, collections, webfinger, nodeinfo, profile, content, sanitize, theme, auth, inbox, circuit_breaker, retry, id, media_integrity). fieldwork-db depends on fieldwork for types + sqlx for persistence. Servers depend on both. Proxy depends only on fieldwork.
